summary: Describes the debugger keyword (2.5+) with values always, never, on_failed, on_unreachable and on_skipped, set at play, role, block or task level, with the most granular definition winning and overriding global config.
questions: What values does the debugger keyword accept?
How do I invoke the debugger only when a host is unreachable?
If debugger is set on a play and a task, which wins?

answer_card.title: The debugger keyword
answer_card.answer_md:
Available since 2.5 on plays, roles, blocks and tasks:

| Value | When |
|---|---|
| `always` | always |
| `never` | never |
| `on_failed` | task fails |
| `on_unreachable` | host unreachable |
| `on_skipped` | task skipped |

The keyword overrides global config, and the **most granular** level wins (task > block > play/role).
